@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=8192)
def default_code_filter(code: CodeType) ->bool:
    # Get the filename of the code object
    filename = code.co_filename
    
    # If filename is empty or not a string, include it (safe default)
    if not filename or not isinstance(filename, str):
        return True
    
    # Convert to pathlib Path for easier comparison
    code_path = pathlib.Path(filename).resolve()
    
    # Check if this is a stdlib or site-packages file
    for lib_path in LIB_PATHS:
        try:
            code_path.relative_to(lib_path)
            # This is a stdlib or site-packages file
            break
        except ValueError:
            continue
    else:
        # Not in stdlib/site-packages, so include it
        return True
    
    # Check if MONKEYTYPE_TRACE_MODULES is set
    trace_modules = os.environ.get('MONKEYTYPE_TRACE_MODULES')
    if trace_modules:
        # Get the module name from the code object
        module_name = code.co_filename.split('/')[-1].split('.')[0] if '/' in code.co_filename else code.co_filename.split('.')[0]
        
        # Check if this module is in the trace modules list
        trace_module_names = [name.strip() for name in trace_modules.split(',')]
        if module_name in trace_module_names:
            return True
    
    # Default behavior: exclude stdlib and site-packages
    return False
